concerns.text: Task T016 configures simulators for Sparsity levels {0.2, 0.4}, but the spec (US-1) and plan require {0.1, 0.2, 0.4}. T016 must precede T015 (simulation generation) to ensure the correct parameter set is available; currently T016 is marked [P] and parallel, but it defines a critical input for T015. If T015 runs before T016 updates the config, it will use defaults or missing values, violating the data-flow dependency.

Task T032 (exclude true-zero coefficients from power denominator) is marked unimplemented but is a prerequisite for the correctness of T029 (calculate empirical power). T029 describes the logic 'filter true_coefficients != 0', but T032 explicitly handles the edge case. T032 must be implemented and logically precede or be integrated into T029 to ensure the power calculation is mathematically valid. Currently, T029 is marked [X] (complete) while its critical dependency T032 is [ ], creating a semantic ordering violation where a consumer task is marked complete before its producer/validator task.

Task T027 (record selected variables and thresholds to CSV) is marked unimplemented [ ], yet T028 and T029 (metrics calculation) depend on this data being written to `data/processed/simulation_results.csv` to be read back for aggregation or verification. The plan states T027 writes to the main results dataframe. If T027 is not done, T028/T029 cannot produce the full required artifact. T027 must precede T028/T029 in the execution order, but the current status implies T028/T029 are complete while T027 is not.

Task T037 (Kruskal-Wallis on simulation-level data) and T038 (Dunn's post-hoc) are marked unimplemented [ ], but T042 (final report) depends on their output. T042 is marked [X] (complete) in the list (implied by context of other completed tasks, though T042 itself is [ ]). More critically, T036 (validate CSV) is marked [ ] and must precede T037. The current ordering allows T037 to be attempted without T036 ensuring the input data exists and is valid. T036 must be a hard prerequisite for T037.

Task T019 description mentions 'explicitly enforce the datasets constraint' but does not clearly state it must run after T013 (downloader) and T018 (dataset selection). While implied by the phase, the dependency is not explicit in the task description, risking a race condition if T019 runs before T018 selects the final 10 datasets.

Task T040 description contains a malformed placeholder 'Alpha thresholds {, conventional significance levels, 0.10}'. This makes the task's input parameters undefined, violating the 'producer before consumer' principle for the visualization logic. The task must be updated to explicitly list {0.01, 0.05, 0.10} before it can be considered a valid producer of plot data.
